title: hangar.run/v1: one captured run
description: The run.json object the outbox writes for every finished agent run (a session turn, a job turn after its check and delivery, a best-of-N attempt after its check, an experiment trial's turn), at v1/runs/{date}/{session_id}.{run_id}/run.json, last of its run's objects. Additions within v1 are new optional properties; anything removed or renamed is a new schema version. Every string has passed through hangar's secret redaction. Contract: docs/api/outbox.md. $defs also holds the shapes of the other objects the outbox writes (job_event, tests).

source.description: experiment: a trial of an experiment job; job: any other job's turn (its own, a best-of-N attempt, the judge); session: a session not carrying a job; shadow: reserved (#183).

run_id.description: The turn's run id: hangar.run.id in the trace, subject.run_id in the manifest. Unique only together with session_id.

turn.description: The turn's number in its session (hangar.turn.number, the manifest's subject.turn).

job_source.description: Where the job came from: api, mcp, cli, github, webhook, schedule, slack, a2a, jira, github-projects, env-setup, experiment.

job_turn.description: The turn's number in its job's turns (null for attempts, the judge and sessions).

start_sha.description: HEAD when the turn started (the manifest's instructions.repo.commit): patch.diff is against it.

head_sha.description: HEAD when the turn ended (the delivered head for a job's last turn).

pinned.description: Ran under a pinned configuration (an experiment variant's pins). Interactive sessions and ordinary jobs: false.

graded.description: The experiment has a grader: grade.json follows (possibly after run.json).

outcome.description: exited | timed_out | cancelled | over_budget | gone | error | needs_input | interrupted

outcome_class.description: agent | infra_error | cancelled | human (#166); null until hangar classifies outcomes. Null means unknown, never agent.

job_state.description: The job's state when the run was captured.

verify.description: The check hangar ran after the turn (trusted). Null for session turns.

rounds.description: Times the in-turn gate sent a failing check back to the agent.

tests.description: Ids of the TestRuns in tests.json.

by_class.description: correction | redirect | new_info counts (#162); empty until steers are classified.

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent of the turn's live invoke_agent span, when tracing was on.

untrusted.description: The job's task text came from someone outside the trusted list (Job.untrusted_source).

diff_files.description: Repo-relative paths the run changed (the delivered change's for a job's last turn, else patch.diff's), at most 1,000.

objects.description: The run's other objects, uploaded before this one.

withheld.description: Objects never uploaded because they still held a secret after redaction.

expects.description: Objects that arrive after run.json (grade.json for a graded trial).

job_event.title: hangar.job_event/v1
job_event.description: v1/jobs/{date}/{job_id}/events/{ts_ms}-{kind}.json: a fact about a job that arrives after its runs. Immutable; one object per fact. {date} is the event's UTC date.

data.description: Per kind: pr.open {draft}; pr.ready {} (#168); review.first {by, sha, first_review_at, first_review_by (#168)}; pr.merge {by, green_to_merge_seconds}; pr.close {}; abandon {reason, by?, via?}; revert {sha} (#168).

tests.title: hangar.tests/v1
tests.description: tests.json: the TestRuns of the run's turn (verify, its flaky rerun and the in-turn gate's runs for a job turn; the attempt's check for an attempt), each with every case's outcome, and their test.run / test.case span events in OTLP/JSON span-event form (docs/api/traces.md).

counted.description: trusted and counts.total > 0 and complete: the field behavior predicates use (#164, added within v1).

agent_run_id.description: The agent run it checked (#164, added within v1).
